login.title: Pick up where your journey left off

register.title: Start a journey with a clear structure

landing.eyebrow: A clear plan for a meaningful trip
landing.title: Journey helps you gather inspiration, keep your prep on track, and begin each trip with a lighter mind.
landing.description: The first phase focuses on a strong foundation: real sign-in, a protected personal area, a clear dashboard, a synced profile, and a steady path toward the trips experience later on.
landing.phaseTitle: Build the foundation properly from the start
landing.phaseDescription: Public and private routes, session restore, a clear session strategy, and core screens that are ready for the next development cycle.
landing.nextDependencyValue: Trips workspace and detailed itinerary planning

plan.title: Plan with structure
plan.description: From sign-in to dashboard to the trips frame, the whole flow is aligned up front so the product does not need heavy rework halfway through.

experience.title: Keep the experience inspiring
experience.description: The visual direction follows a warm travel journal with room to breathe and a clear point of view instead of a generic dashboard.

community.title: Expand into community at the right time
community.description: Community stays in teaser mode for now so the interface evolves at the right pace instead of drifting into avoidable rework.

community.title: A corner for community inspiration
community.description: For now this area is a teaser that keeps the product's sense of inspiration alive. Feed, likes, comments, and full post details will open in a later phase.
community.postPlaceholderDescription: The detail route is already in place so real content can connect later without changing the structure. In this phase, the screen stays intentionally simple and avoids fake interactions.

haGiang.title: A slow 4-day loop through Ha Giang
haGiang.summary: A sample story that preserves the visual tone before the full community feed opens.

hue.title: A weekend food checklist for Hue
hue.summary: Read-only preview content that does not pretend to be a complete interactive feed.

dashboard.title: Hi {{name}}, your next journey is waiting to be scheduled.
dashboard.description: This space is your quick bridge to create a new trip, reopen your current list, and continue planning the next journey.

planner.description: Use this section to add multiple major stops inside one trip, attach dates, time, cost, notes, multiple image URLs, and then add child places or tasks underneath each stop.

planner.childFormDescription: Child places or tasks can also include time, cost, notes, and multiple images.
planner.budgetDescription: Track the total budget, the amount already planned, and the remaining room without leaving the trip detail page.
